scripts.build: uv run --locked --no-dev --isolated sphinx-build -M html src/user build/public -c src --fail-on-warning
scripts.build:internal: uv run --locked --no-dev --isolated sphinx-build -M html src build/internal --fail-on-warning
scripts.clean: uv run --locked sphinx-build -M clean src build
scripts.clean:internal: uv run --locked sphinx-build -M clean src build/internal
scripts.clean:public: uv run --locked sphinx-build -M clean src/user build/public
scripts.dev: pnpm run clean:public && uv run --locked sphinx-autobuild -M html src/user build/public -c src --watch src/conf.py --fail-on-warning
scripts.dev:internal: pnpm run clean:internal && uv run --locked sphinx-autobuild -M html src build/internal --fail-on-warning
